subject: Request: One-time onboarding credit for Graceful Health (501c3)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: One-time onboarding credit for Graceful Health (501c3)

Hi team,

I’m working with Graceful Health (regional nonprofit, pediatric care) and they’re requesting an onboarding credit to cover initial integration and data ingestion costs. They provided proof of 501(c)(3) status and a concise mutual action plan — attached.

Context:
- ACV expected first 12 months: ~$120k (low-touch, healthcare vertical).
- Pilot start: Nov 2026, with expected production go-live Feb 2027.
- Primary ask: a one-time onboarding credit of $35,000 to offset the implementation vendor and internal data-prep costs.

Why I’m asking for an exception: Graceful Health is grant-funded and cannot absorb upfront implementation fees. This pilot is strategic for our nonprofit vertical motion and could surface additional references and PR. We’re proposing the credit be applied as a bill credit across Q1 invoices (not a discount to list price).

Requested approvals: VP/CFO signoff for a one-time $35k credit and agreement to treat as a non-refundable onboarding credit applied over the first 3 invoices. Legal has not yet redlined SOW; procurement will need invoice language to ensure credit application.

Attachments: 501c3 proof, mutual action plan, draft SOW.

Happy to jump on a quick call — Sean and I can host the customer conversation.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales (Nonprofit & Social Impact)
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
p: (415) 555-0119
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit for Graceful Health (501c3)

Naomi — thanks for the context. A couple of quick items I need before I can approve anything at that magnitude:

1) Confirmed ARR / expected revenue cadence over 12 months (breakdown by quarter).
2) A clear justification that this is not setting a precedent for other deals (i.e., one-off, nonprofit/grant constraint documented).
3) Confirm whether the credit reduces recognized revenue or will be treated as contra-revenue for accounting (we prefer a bill credit applied after invoicing).
4) Legal procurement sign-off and a copy of the 501(c)(3).

If you can get the above into a single-page memo, I can review and get Marissa looped for commercial exceptions.

-Markus
Markus Klein
CFO, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit for Graceful Health (501c3)

Markus — thanks, attached is a short memo and the financials asked for. Key points below and attached spreadsheet:

- Expected 12-month revenue: $120,000 (Q1: $20k, Q2: $30k, Q3: $35k, Q4: $35k).
- Payment terms: Net 30 after invoice; first invoice scheduled for 2026-11-15 (pilot fee + seats).
- Precedent: Graceful’s model is grant-funded with strict cashflow constraints. We’re requesting this as a one-time, documented exception for the nonprofit vertical; we’ll track any similar asks in our deal exceptions log.
- Accounting treatment: Requested as a bill credit applied across first three invoices (contra-revenue treatment; finance to confirm final booking entries).
- Attachments: GracefulHealth_501c3.pdf, GHealth_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, GracefulHealth_SOW_draft.docx

Commercial ask rationale: the credit ensures we don’t lose the pilot to an implementation vendor the customer prefers (vendor has fronted costs). This keeps the pilot timeline intact and preserves the expected ACV.

Action: Would appreciate conditional approval (Markus) and a commercial exception memo (Marissa) to proceed to procurement/legal for final SOW language.

Thanks — I can be on the call with Emily next Tuesday (10/19) at 10am PT.

—Naomi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit for Graceful Health (501c3)

Thanks Naomi — reviewed the memo and attachments. Commercially I’m comfortable with a one-time onboarding credit provided we:

- Tie the credit explicitly to the SOW milestone schedule (credit applied only after the first invoice posts).
- Limit to this 501(c)(3) customer and flag in the exceptions register with a short business case (Naomi to fill template).
- Require procurement to acknowledge vendor invoices and confirm that vendor will be paid from the credit allocation (no double-dipping).

Proposed compromise: Approve up to $25,000 in immediate bill credit; the remaining $10,000 will be contingent on a customer success milestone (production-ready by 3/1/2027) and review after 90 days. This reduces cash exposure while preserving runway for the pilot.

Naomi — if you can get procurement to confirm vendor billing flow and update the memo, I’ll draft the commercial exception memo for VP sign-off. Markus — can you confirm accounting treatment (contra-revenue vs. credit memo) so Legal/Procurement know how to phrase it?

-Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit for Graceful Health (501c3) — Conditional Approval

Team — after reviewing the updated materials and Marissa’s proposed compromise, I’m granting conditional approval:

- Immediate bill credit approved: $25,000.
- Contingent credit: $10,000 to be released if Graceful Health reaches production-ready milestone by 2027-03-01 and customer success signs off after 90 days.
- Accounting treatment: finance will book as contra-revenue (credit memos against invoices). I’ll work with Revenue Ops to ensure proper booking codes.
- Conditions: Legal must include explicit credit language in the SOW, procurement must confirm vendor billing flow (attachment with vendor invoice routing required), and Naomi must complete the exceptions template and record in the deal exceptions register.

Naomi/Marissa — please proceed to confirm procurement/legal language and loop me if there are material changes. Once Legal confirms SOW language I’ll sign the discrete commercial exception memo.

-Markus

CFO, Redwood Inference
